EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

Vice President of Engineering with 18 years in software organisations, the last
nine leading engineering functions through growth, acquisition and turnaround.
Builds engineering organisations that ship predictably and cost less per unit of
delivery each year. Sits on the executive team and owns the technology plan,
engineering budget and vendor strategy.
